tool_calls.input:
const r = await tools.exec_command({cmd:"python3 -B -c '
import json, sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, "tools")
from i18nlib.config import load_manifest
from i18nlib.runtime import LuaRuntime
from i18nlib.locale_model import LocaleLoader
root=Path.cwd()
files=["mod-tome.lua","tome-ashes-urhrok.lua","tome-cults.lua","tome-orcs.lua"]
manifest=load_manifest()
runtime=LuaRuntime(manifest)
probe=runtime.doctor()
loader=LocaleLoader(runtime)
changed=[]
current_by_key={}
for name in files:
    before=loader.load_path(root/".ai/task/repair-w62-20261001/baseline"/name, logical_path=name)
    after=loader.load_path(root/name, logical_path=name)
    assert len(before.records)==len(after.records), (name,len(before.records),len(after.records))
    for index,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(before.records,after.records)):
        aa={k:v for k,v in a.items() if k!="target"}
        bb={k:v for k,v in b.items() if k!="target"}
        assert aa==bb, (name,index,"non-target field changed")
        if a.get("target")!=b.get("target"):
            assert a.get("kind")=="translation"
            changed.append((name,index,a.get("source"),a.get("source_tag"),a.get("target"),b.get("target")))
        if b.get("kind")=="translation":
            current_by_key.setdefault((name,b.get("source"),b.get("source_tag")),[]).append(b)
work=json.loads((root/".ai/task/repair-w62-20261001/WORKSET.json").read_text())["items"]
assert len(changed)==53, len(changed)
assert len(work)==53
for item in work:
    key=(item["normalized_path"],item["source"],item.get("source_tag"))
    matches=[r for r in current_by_key.get(key,[]) if any(c[0]==key[0] and c[2]==key[1] and c[3]==key[2] and c[4]==item["target_preimage"] for c in changed)]
    assert matches, ("workset item not represented",item["entry_revision_identity"])
env=json.loads((root/".ai/task/repair-w62-20261001/CONTEXTUAL-ENVELOPE-r0a1.json").read_text())["payload"]["translation_snapshot"]
env_by={x["revision_key"]:x for x in env}
round_changes=[]
for item in work:
    key=(item["normalized_path"],item["source"],item.get("source_tag"))
    candidates=current_by_key[key]
    assert len(candidates)==1, ("ambiguous runtime key",key,len(candidates))
    now=candidates[0]["target"]
    prior=env_by[item["entry_revision_identity"]]["target"]
    if now!=prior:
        round_changes.append((item["entry_revision_identity"],item["normalized_path"],prior,now))
expected={
"5dc5712a745a174e866a33a5aa23d56ac3e3251a23fff7b3a5c5fdcc731f98f8":("当目标受伤害时，受害者也会承受 %d%% 的伤害。","当目标受伤害时，另一名受害者也会承受 %d%% 的伤害。"),
"dccaeba2d425909676f183e3720a2019a857a3ab2fc4efb975a1c63c21807799":("并将其扔进了海里","并将其冲进了大海")}
assert {x[0]:(x[2],x[3]) for x in round_changes}==expected, round_changes
print("Lua runtime:",probe["lua_version"],probe["luajit_version"],"LPeg",probe["lpeg_version"])
print("Loaded files:",", ".join(files))
print("Baseline target-only changes:",len(changed))
print("Round-1 target changes:",len(round_changes))
for key,name,old,new in round_changes: print(key[:10],name,repr(old),"->",repr(new))
print("Non-target fields unchanged: yes")
'","workdir":"/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation","yield_time_ms":30000,"max_output_tokens":12000}); text(r.output); text(`exit_code=${r.exit_code}`);
